commandRun.title: Run a command
commandRun.description: Fires a studio command by its identifier, exactly as a keyboard shortcut or a menu item would. The document it applies to has to be in front.

workspaceOpen.title: Open a workspace
workspaceOpen.description: Switches to a workspace, and creates a document there when asked to. This is what answers “open a new 3D file”.

modelsSearch.title: Search for a model
modelsSearch.description: Searches generation models by keywords, narrowed to one family when a family is given. Changes nothing on screen.

modelsSelect.title: Pick a model
modelsSelect.description: Arms a model for a generation family. The Generator’s form is then rebuilt on that model’s own fields.

generatorPrepare.title: Prepare a generation
generatorPrepare.description: Fills the Generator’s form with a model and its parameters, then shows it. Nothing is sent, and the generation is still to be started.

generatorSubmit.title: Start the prepared generation
generatorSubmit.description: Sends the form as it stands on screen. Spends creative units, whose estimate is stated before anything is committed.

jobsList.title: List the jobs
jobsList.description: Returns the generations under way and how far along they are, as the studio tracks them. Changes nothing on screen.

promptSuggest.title: Suggest prompt variants
promptSuggest.description: Rewrites a sentence into several variants cut for the model armed in the Generator, with the settings that go with them. Spends nothing and changes nothing on screen.

promptTranslate.title: Translate a prompt into English
promptTranslate.description: Carries a text into the language the models are trained on, and says which language it recognised. Spends nothing and changes nothing on screen.

chatClose.title: Close the conversation
chatClose.description: Clears the conversation off the screen so that what was just done can be seen. Call it last, when the result is on screen — a space opened, a form filled. Do not call it when the answer is the words themselves, nor when permission is being asked for.

promptDescribeStyle.title: Describe the style of the references
promptDescribeStyle.description: Reads the reference images sitting on the Generator’s form and returns a description usable as a prompt. Spends nothing.

studioState.title: Read the studio’s state
studioState.description: Returns the open project, the active workspace and surface, every open document with the one in front marked, the model armed per family, and whether the studio is signed in. Ask this before firing a command: a command only reaches the surface that is active.

documentsList.title: List the project’s documents
documentsList.description: Returns every document the project folder holds, open in a tab or not, with its path, kind and workspace. Changes nothing on screen.

documentOpen.title: Open a document
documentOpen.description: Opens a document of the project folder by its path and brings it to the front, switching workspace as needed. The path is the one a listing gave.

documentActivate.title: Bring a document to the front
documentActivate.description: Makes an already open document the active tab, so that commands aimed at its surface reach it. This is the answer to a command refused for being on the wrong surface.

documentClose.title: Close a document
documentClose.description: Closes an open document’s tab. Work that never reached the disk is lost with it, which is why this asks first.

documentRename.title: Rename a document
documentRename.description: Calls a document something else, on disk and on screen at once. The document keeps its identity, so an open tab renames without closing.

activityRecent.title: Read the recent activity
activityRecent.description: Returns what the studio has recorded lately — generations, file operations, failures — newest first. This is how to find out what an action actually did.

projectOpen.title: Open a project folder
projectOpen.description: Opens a project from an absolute path on this machine, without raising the system dialogue a person would use. Answers whether the folder was a project.

projectCreate.title: Create a project folder
projectCreate.description: Makes a new project at an absolute path on this machine and opens it, without raising the system dialogue a person would use.

filesList.title: List a folder
filesList.description: Returns the entries of one folder of the open project, files and folders alike, with the path each is known by. Give no folder to list the project root.

filesSearch.title: Search the project’s files
filesSearch.description: Searches the whole open project by name and returns the matching entries with their paths. Changes nothing on screen.

filesMove.title: Move files
filesMove.description: Moves files and folders of the project into another folder of it. The disk changes, so this asks first — the Explorer can still undo it afterwards.

filesCopy.title: Copy files
filesCopy.description: Copies files and folders of the project into another folder of it, leaving the originals where they are.

filesDuplicate.title: Duplicate files
filesDuplicate.description: Makes a copy of each named file or folder beside it, under a name the studio picks so nothing is overwritten.

filesTrash.title: Move files to the bin
filesTrash.description: Sends files and folders of the project to the system bin. This asks first, and what it took is listed in the recent activity.

fileRename.title: Rename a file
fileRename.description: Gives one file or folder of the project another name, in the folder it already sits in. This asks first: another program may already know it by the old one.

fileFacts.title: Read a file’s facts
fileFacts.description: Returns what the filesystem records about one entry — its kind, its size in bytes, when it was created and last changed. Changes nothing on screen.

folderNew.title: Create a folder
folderNew.description: Makes a new folder inside a folder of the open project. Answers with the path it was given, which may differ if the name was taken.

modelSchema.title: Read a model’s own inputs
modelSchema.description: Returns the fields one generation model accepts, with their kinds and bounds, as the studio builds its form from. This is what to fill the parameters of a prepared generation with.

costEstimate.title: Estimate what a generation would cost
costEstimate.description: Prices a model and a set of parameters without running anything. Answers nothing at all where the API declines to price that model, rather than inventing a figure.

jobGet.title: Read one job
jobGet.description: Returns one generation whole — its status, how far along it is, what it produced, what it cost, and why it failed if it did.

jobWait.title: Wait for a job to finish
jobWait.description: Waits until a generation succeeds, fails or is cancelled, then returns it with the assets it produced. Returns the job as it stands if the wait runs out, which is an answer rather than a failure.

jobCancel.title: Cancel a job
jobCancel.description: Stops a generation that is still queued or running. What has already been spent is not given back.

usageReport.title: Read the usage report
usageReport.description: Returns what the account has spent over a window of seven, thirty-one or a hundred and twenty days, as the usage window shows it.

assetsSearch.title: Search the library
assetsSearch.description: Searches the project’s assets by text, kind and tags, and can narrow to what was generated. Answers with the rows the catalogue holds.

assetsCounts.title: Count the library
assetsCounts.description: Returns how many assets of each kind the project holds, counted in the catalogue rather than by listing them.

assetGet.title: Read assets
assetGet.description: Returns everything the catalogue holds about the named assets — where they are, what they came from, and how they are tagged. This is what to call on the ids a finished generation handed back.

assetUpdate.title: Correct an asset
assetUpdate.description: Changes an asset’s name, its tags, or the kind the studio read from its extension. Tags are replaced whole, so an empty list genuinely clears them.

assetsRemove.title: Remove assets
assetsRemove.description: Takes assets out of the project’s library, and out of the remote one when asked to. This asks first, and what it removed is listed in the recent activity.

refusals.unknownCommand: No such command exists in the studio.
refusals.globalCommand: That command belongs to the application menu, which fires it itself.
refusals.wrongSurface: That command speaks to a document that is not in front.
refusals.generatorClosed: The Generator was not open. It is now.
refusals.nothingPrepared: The Generator has no model armed at the moment.
refusals.notSubmitted: The generation did not go out.
refusals.badInput: The parameters given do not suit this action.
refusals.noConfirmer: That action needs a yes, and no window was there to give one.
refusals.noWindow: No studio window was in front to run that action.
refusals.timedOut: The request stood on screen unanswered, and was given up on.
refusals.noReference: The form carries no reference image to read a style from.
refusals.formChanged: The form changed after the cost was quoted. Nothing was sent — ask again for a fresh figure.

models.claude-haiku-4-5: Haiku 4.5 — the fastest and the cheapest
models.claude-opus-4-8: Opus 4.8 — the most reliable over several steps

fields.title: Title
fields.name: Name
fields.filePath: Path inside the project, with / between segments
fields.filePaths: Paths inside the project, with / between segments
fields.timeoutMs: How long to wait at most, in milliseconds
fields.alsoRemote: Remove from the remote library too

assistant.title: Assistant
assistant.writeHint: Opens the assistant so you can write what you want done
assistant.reviewHint: Opens the assistant to show what it understood and what it did
assistant.dismissHint: Removes this reminder. What the assistant did stays in its window
assistant.empty: Say what you want done, and the assistant does it.
assistant.placeholder: Open a 3D file, find a model, prepare a generation…
assistant.sendHint: Sends the sentence to the assistant, which picks the actions and runs them
assistant.closeHint: Closes the window without cancelling anything already under way
assistant.modelHint: Picks the model that reads your sentences. The cheapest is enough to open a workspace, the others hold up better on requests that take several steps.
assistant.lost: The assistant could not answer that one.

confirm.unknownCost: This action will spend creative units. The studio could not estimate how many, and does not invent a figure.
confirm.files: This action will change files in your project folder. It costs no creative units, and the Explorer can undo it.
confirm.asset: This action will upload an image, which then stays in your library. It costs no creative units.
confirm.yesHint: Runs the action above, and commits what it commits
confirm.noHint: Runs nothing, and the assistant takes it into account for what follows
